Thank you for the change.

At this stage ZetaSDR does not merge pull requests. Please open a
[Gist issue](https://github.com/ciphernaut/ZetaSDR/issues/new?template=gist.yml) that links this
diff (or a GitHub gist of it) and says what it does and why. The maintainer may adopt it in a
commit that credits you with a `Suggested-by:` line; see [CONTRIBUTING.md](https://github.com/ciphernaut/ZetaSDR/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md).
